caption: The drawing features a cross made from wooden objects, with the vertical beam formed by a staff or stick and the horizontal beam formed by a piece of wood attached across it. At the top of the vertical beam, a hammer is fastened, its handle aligned with the vertical beam and its head resting above. Each end of the horizontal wood has what appears to be a pair of black, slotted, pincer-like tools. The wood is depicted in shades of brown with visible grain, while the metal objects are colored in dark gray or black. The cross is adorned with green, needle-like foliage, possibly resembling pine, and several pink and yellow flowers at the intersection of the beams. A large, light pink bow is tied around the intersection, with its ends hanging down over the vertical beam. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or patterns. In the bottom right corner, there is a handwritten inscription that reads, "MAJEL G. CLOFLIN-TAOS-N.M." indicating the artist and location.
title: Carved Cross - Grave
